comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Howl (3-knob). build.py reads THIS file. Tuned 2-pole resonator feedback howl; Level scales the howl output.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> SONAME prefix ZDL_DLY_. Grouped under DLY (fewest stock effects = easy to find).
fxid_comment: 0x01CA. Reverted from 480 to the last known-working id + safe default. (The 480 bump collided with stock effect fxids and broke on hardware; the audible-on-load Mix hack is obsolete now the editor materialises patches via a full-patch send.)

params.name: Annihil
params.comment: params[6]. Pole radius: short ring -> long howl.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade. Renamed from 'Level' so every effect in the pack ends with the same control.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
